targets.rawSql: SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", "TotalLoad[MW]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."ActualTotalLoad" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY "DateTime(UTC)" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '3 days' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') ORDER BY "DateTime(UTC)" DESC LIMIT 1

WITH latest_load AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, "TotalLoad[MW]" AS load_mw FROM entsoe_fms."ActualTotalLoad" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' ORDER BY "DateTime(UTC)" DESC LIMIT 1), latest_vres AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, SUM("ActualGenerationOutput[MW]") AS vres_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" WHERE "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" IN ('Solar', 'Wind Onshore', 'Wind Offshore') AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '2 days' GROUP BY 1) SELECT l.ts AS "time", l.load_mw - COALESCE(v.vres_mw, 0) AS "value" FROM latest_load l LEFT JOIN latest_vres v ON v.ts = l.ts

WITH imports AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, SUM("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS import_mw FROM entsoe_fms."ForecastedTransferCapacities" WHERE "InAreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "ContractType" = '$Transfer_Contract' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() AND "DateTime(UTC)" < now() + interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1), exports AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, SUM("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS export_mw FROM entsoe_fms."ForecastedTransferCapacities" WHERE "OutAreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "ContractType" = '$Transfer_Contract' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() AND "DateTime(UTC)" < now() + interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1) SELECT now() AS "time", AVG(COALESCE(i.import_mw, 0) - COALESCE(e.export_mw, 0)) AS "value" FROM imports i FULL OUTER JOIN exports e ON e.ts = i.ts

WITH vres AS (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS ts, SUM("ActualGenerationOutput[MW]") AS vres_mw FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" IN ('Solar', 'Wind Onshore', 'Wind Offshore') GROUP BY 1) SELECT l."DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", 'Total Load' AS "metric", l."TotalLoad[MW]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."ActualTotalLoad" l WHERE l."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND l."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND l."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND l."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' UNION ALL SELECT d."DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", 'Day-ahead Generation' AS "metric", d."GenerationForecast[MW]" AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."DayAheadAggregatedGeneration" d WHERE d."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND d."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND d."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND d."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' UNION ALL SELECT l."DateTime(UTC)" AS "time", 'Residual Load' AS "metric", l."TotalLoad[MW]" - COALESCE(v.vres_mw, 0) AS "value" FROM entsoe_fms."ActualTotalLoad" l LEFT JOIN vres v ON v.ts = l."DateTime(UTC)" WHERE l."DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND l."DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND l."AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND l."AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' ORDER BY 1, 2

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval), metric, AVG(value) AS "value" FROM (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Day-ahead Hourly' AS metric, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Day-ahead 15m' AS metric, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND "Sequence" = '2' UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Intraday 15m' AS metric, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND "Sequence" = '3') s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval), metric, AVG(value) AS "value" FROM (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Actual' AS metric, "ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Day-ahead Forecast' AS metric, "DayAheadGenerationForecast[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" = '$RES_Type' UNION ALL SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, 'Current Forecast' AS metric, "CurrentGenerationForecast[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."GenerationForecastsForWindAndSolar" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type' AND "ProductionType" = '$RES_Type') s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(my_time, $__interval), metric, AVG(value) AS "value" FROM (SELECT "DateTime(UTC)" AS my_time, "ProductionType" AS metric, "ActualGenerationOutput[MW]" AS value FROM entsoe_fms."AggregatedGenerationPerType" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= to_timestamp($__from / 1000.0) AND "DateTime(UTC)" <= to_timestamp($__to / 1000.0) AND "AreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "AreaTypeCode" = '$Area_Type') s GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

WITH val_map (grafana_label, db_name) AS (VALUES ('Albania (AL)', 'Albania'), ('Austria (AT)', 'Austria'), ('Belgium (BE)', 'Belgium'), ('Bosnia and Herz. (BA)', 'Bosnia and Herzegovina'), ('Bulgaria (BG)', 'Bulgaria'), ('Croatia (HR)', 'Croatia'), ('Cyprus (CY)', 'Cyprus'), ('Czech Republic (CZ)', 'Czechia'), ('Denmark (DK)', 'Denmark'), ('DK', 'Denmark'), ('DK1', 'Denmark'), ('DK2', 'Denmark'), ('Estonia (EE)', 'Estonia'), ('Finland (FI)', 'Finland'), ('France (FR)', 'France'), ('Germany (DE)', 'Germany'), ('DE(50Hertz)', 'Germany'), ('DE(Amprion)', 'Germany'), ('DE(TenneT GER)', 'Germany'), ('DE(TransnetBW)', 'Germany'), ('DE-LU', 'Germany'), ('Greece (GR)', 'Greece'), ('Hungary (HU)', 'Hungary'), ('Ireland (IE)', 'Ireland'), ('IE(SEM)', 'Ireland'), ('Italy (IT)', 'Italy'), ('IT-Calabria', 'Italy'), ('IT-Centre-North', 'Italy'), ('IT-Centre-South', 'Italy'), ('IT-North', 'Italy'), ('IT-Sardinia', 'Italy'), ('IT-Sicily', 'Italy'), ('IT-South', 'Italy'), ('Kosovo (XK)', 'Kosovo'), ('Latvia (LV)', 'Latvia'), ('Lithuania (LT)', 'Lithuania'), ('Luxembourg (LU)', 'Luxembourg'), ('Moldova (MD)', 'Moldova'), ('Montenegro (ME)', 'Montenegro'), ('Netherlands (NL)', 'Netherlands'), ('North Macedonia (MK)', 'North Macedonia'), ('Norway (NO)', 'Norway'), ('NO1', 'Norway'), ('NO2', 'Norway'), ('NO3', 'Norway'), ('NO4', 'Norway'), ('NO5', 'Norway'), ('Poland (PL)', 'Poland'), ('Portugal (PT)', 'Portugal'), ('Romania (RO)', 'Romania'), ('Serbia (RS)', 'Serbia'), ('Slovakia (SK)', 'Slovakia'), ('Slovenia (SI)', 'Slovenia'), ('Spain (ES)', 'Spain'), ('Sweden (SE)', 'Sweden'), ('SE1', 'Sweden'), ('SE2', 'Sweden'), ('SE3', 'Sweden'), ('SE4', 'Sweden'), ('Switzerland (CH)', 'Switzerland'), ('United Kingdom (UK)', 'United Kingdom'), ('GB', 'United Kingdom'), ('Ukraine (UA)', 'Ukraine')), latest_prices AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("AreaDisplayName") "AreaDisplayName" AS area_name, "Price[Currency/MWh]" AS price_mwh, "DateTime(UTC)" AS price_time FROM entsoe_fms."EnergyPrices" WHERE "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() - interval '3 days' AND "AreaTypeCode" = 'BZN' AND (TRIM(COALESCE("Sequence", '')) = '' OR "Sequence" = '1') ORDER BY "AreaDisplayName", "DateTime(UTC)" DESC), country_centroids AS (SELECT country AS db_name, AVG(lat) AS lat, AVG(lon) AS lon FROM entsoe_fms.powersystemdata WHERE lat IS NOT NULL AND lon IS NOT NULL GROUP BY country), country_prices AS (SELECT m.db_name, AVG(lp.price_mwh) AS price_mwh, MAX(lp.price_time) AS price_time, COUNT(*) AS bidding_zones FROM latest_prices lp JOIN val_map m ON m.grafana_label = lp.area_name GROUP BY m.db_name) SELECT 0 AS "time", cc.lat, cc.lon, cp.db_name AS name, cp.db_name AS country, cp.price_mwh, cp.bidding_zones, cp.price_time FROM country_prices cp JOIN country_centroids cc ON cc.db_name = cp.db_name ORDER BY cp.price_mwh DESC

WITH next_24h AS (SELECT 'Import' AS direction, "OutAreaDisplayName" AS neighbour, AVG("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS avg_capacity_mw, MIN("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS min_capacity_mw, MAX("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS max_capacity_mw FROM entsoe_fms."ForecastedTransferCapacities" WHERE "InAreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "ContractType" = '$Transfer_Contract' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() AND "DateTime(UTC)" < now() + interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'Export' AS direction, "InAreaDisplayName" AS neighbour, AVG("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS avg_capacity_mw, MIN("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS min_capacity_mw, MAX("ForecastTransferCapacity[MW]") AS max_capacity_mw FROM entsoe_fms."ForecastedTransferCapacities" WHERE "OutAreaDisplayName" = '$Country' AND "ContractType" = '$Transfer_Contract' AND "DateTime(UTC)" >= now() AND "DateTime(UTC)" < now() + interval '24 hours' GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT direction, neighbour, ROUND(avg_capacity_mw::numeric, 1) AS avg_capacity_mw, ROUND(min_capacity_mw::numeric, 1) AS min_capacity_mw, ROUND(max_capacity_mw::numeric, 1) AS max_capacity_mw FROM next_24h ORDER BY avg_capacity_mw DESC
